name: Cafe-Trical-Cafe
original_name: カフェトリカルカフェ
source:
Race of Love, starting from a café.

Spring passes and summer is coming. The only thing Kiritani Shuusuke's good at is making coffee.
He transfers to Kiyama Academy and move to its dormitory.
In that evening, He meets a senior.

"Kiritani Shuusuke-kun, would you like to work with me at Arte?"
In front of his eyes is a hand of Shinomori Yomogi, tiny and slim.
Unable to resist, he reaches out his hand.
"If you don't mind then I'd love to."
In that moment, his world unfrozen.
That's right, This is the start of his wonderful café lif--

"Hey, nii-san! Taking a part-time job without telling your little sister? This will not do!"
"Shuu-kun! Me, your childhood friend, is here to help!"
"Darling, here am I."
Just as he gets excited about his café life, three girls show up.

His blood-related little sister, Kiritani Aoi
A childhood friend he's never seen in 5 years, Tachibana Mia
and, out of nowhere, a pretty girl calling him "darling", Shiina Serika

"I am *the one and only sister of nii-san!* I'll never let anyone take him away from me!"
"Noooo! Shuu-kun's first kiss will be mine!"
"I'm his *legal wife*. None of your efforts will ever be useful."
"Shuusuke? *Popular*, aren't ya? *Don't you remember* I'm the first girl to reach out to you?"

Love rivalry of girls with over 200% affection in a cafe known as "Arte"!
Who will be the one to win over him?!

The race has now begun!

(translated from https://madosoft.net/cafetrical/story.html)
translation:
爱情的竞赛，从咖啡馆开始。

春天过去了，夏天即将到来。桐谷周介唯一擅长的就是煮咖啡。
他转学到木山学院并搬进宿舍。
那天晚上，他遇到了一位前辈。

“桐谷周助君，你愿意和我一起在Arte工作吗？”
眼前是筱森四木的一只手，纤细纤细。
他无法反抗，伸出了手。
“如果你不介意的话，我很乐意。”
那一刻，他的世界解冻了。
没错，这就是他美妙的咖啡馆生活的开始——

“喂，哥哥！瞒着妹妹去打工？这样不行啊！”
“修君！我，你的青梅竹马，是来帮忙的！”
“亲爱的，我在这儿。”
正当他对咖啡馆生活感到兴奋时，三个女孩出现了。

与他有血缘关系的妹妹桐谷葵
五年未见的青梅竹马立花美亚
突然，一个漂亮的女孩叫他“亲爱的”，椎名瑟里卡

“我是*哥哥唯一的妹妹！*我永远不会让任何人把他从我身边夺走！”
“不不！修君的初吻是我的！”
“我是他的‘合法妻子’。你的一切努力都不会有用。”
“修介？*受欢迎*，不是吗？*你不记得*我是第一个向你伸出援手的女孩吗？”

好感度超过200%的少女们，在名为“Arte”的咖啡馆展开爱情竞争！
谁能战胜他？！

比赛现在开始了！

（翻译自https://madosoft.net/cafetrical/story.html）
